notes.title: Hop on Board!
notes.notes: Strange Ocean is out on the open seas now!!!

notes.title: Setting Sail Soon!
notes.notes:
Strange Ocean releases on August 5th!

Bonus: Your demo save data will carry over to the released game! If you collected some treasure chests in the demo then prepare to use those to get some new hull ornaments.

If you played the demo before this post then you'll need to open the demo again before playing the full game to keep your save data.
